Steps.1: Open the schematic and the board of the hw_DAA.
Steps.2: Run command: 'run length IMX_DMCK_P IMX_DMCK_N IMX_DMO_P IMX_DMO_N'.
Steps.3: Run command: 'run length MIPI_S_CLK_P MIPI_S_CLK_N MIPI_S_D0_P MIPI_S_D0_N'.
Steps.4: Run command: 'run length MIPI_CM_CLK_P MIPI_CM_CLK_N MIPI_CM_D0_P MIPI_CM_D0_N'.
Steps.5: Sum all the lengths of the signals of the MIPI interface.
Steps.6: Check that the maximum length difference between the routed signals of the MIPI interface is within the expected values.
